summary: WeRide Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 12, 2026, attaching a Hong Kong Stock Exchange announcement of unaudited financial results for Q2 and H1 2026. The announcement reports Q2 total revenue of RMB231.7 million, up 82.2% year-over-year, and highlights accelerated European expansion. No special-situation transaction is involved; this is a routine earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer. The filing includes no deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors. What to watch: continued overseas revenue growth and potential strategic moves in Europe, but no transactional event is pending.
